items.problem: `PEER_REJOINED` of an index for which RealtimeCore has not called `connect_peer` yet (reachable when `MATCH_FOUND` and `PEER_REJOINED` are read in one `poll`, or `MATCH_REJOINED` of `rejoin_match` and `PEER_REJOINED` of another participant are read in one `poll`, because the transport reads the frames of a `poll` before raising notifications, line 107) makes the transport "start a new connection the same as `connect_peer`", while line 129 keeps `PEER_SIGNAL` received before `connect_peer` collected until `connect_peer`. What the later `connect_peer` of RealtimeCore does for that index (no-op on the started connection, or drop it and start another with the next connection attempt number and a second offer), and whether signals after that `PEER_REJOINED` are still collected, is not set, so the sent `PEER_SIGNAL` sequence can differ per implementation
